findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: organisation_search, organisation_profile · Private data: risk_sentiment, macro_news, release_calendar, release_calendar_visual_artifact, event_predictions, latest_announcements, press_releases, rate_curve, rate_differentials, forex, seasonality, indicator_query, plot_visual_artifact, macro_briefing_task, macro_heatmap_task, event_impact_replay_task, fx_trade_setup_task, fx_backtest_task, market_sessions, cot_data, commodities, catalogue_search, catalogue_related, organisation_search, organisation_profile, official_datasets · Public sink: rate_curve · Destructive: fx_backtest_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: organisation_search, organisation_profile · Private data: risk_sentiment, macro_news, release_calendar, release_calendar_visual_artifact, event_predictions, latest_announcements, press_releases, rate_curve, rate_differentials, forex, seasonality, indicator_query, plot_visual_artifact, macro_briefing_task, macro_heatmap_task, event_impact_replay_task, fx_trade_setup_task, fx_backtest_task, market_sessions, cot_data, commodities, catalogue_search, catalogue_related, organisation_search, organisation_profile, official_datasets · Public sink: rate_curve · Destructive: fx_backtest_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
